purpose: Preimplementation process graph for a desktop supervisor that can launch optional Claude Code CLI, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, and OpenCode lanes, capture bounded terminal output, and release accepted structured summaries through a merge gate.

artifacts.cleanup_policy: Prune raw logs according to terminal output retention settings.
validation: Secret redaction runs before durable promotion.

resource_controls.timeout_policy: Each lane has timeout_seconds; timeout pauses the lane and releases unrelated lanes for continued work.
resource_controls.cancellation_policy: Cancel child processes through the supervisor and close stdin/stdout/stderr handles when a lane is stopped.
resource_controls.cleanup_policy: Close PTY or stream handles, prune bounded raw logs, and remove temporary artifacts when a run is cancelled or archived.
resource_controls.orphan_process_policy: Track process groups per lane and terminate descendants on app exit, workspace close, or explicit cancellation.
resource_controls.backpressure_policy: Stream visible terminal output with bounded buffers and spill large logs to artifact files before durable structuring.

merge_strategy: The merge_cli_outputs gate accepts only bounded, redacted, structured summaries and blocks source-affecting actions until pending human decisions are resolved.
plan_evidence: The user requested a desktop platform that can run multiple AI CLIs above a CLI-neutral orchestration layer.
Existing shared CLI adapter policy requires optional adapters and capability_missing fallback rather than single-CLI dependence.
The decision inbox and omission-prevention rules require pausing only affected work when a human decision is needed.
rollback_plan: Do not enable the supervisor runtime until adapter smoke tests pass for at least one installed CLI.
If any lane fails adapter detection, mark that adapter capability_missing and keep the desktop shell usable.
If merge or question detection is uncertain, route the run to human review and avoid changing source files.
notes: This record validates the planned process graph only. It does not execute Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, OpenCode, or install dependencies.
